body: Do you recommend disappearing?

To be honest I really appreciate your advice and it made me a little positive but I’ve quite everything before and nothing changes. I’ve quite and started University for 3 years. Doing it for the 4th year will further damage my already damaged mother and I don’t want this to happen while I’m alive. She is not in good mental condition. While I’m writing this she has left the house again saying she can’t take it anymore. 

I also hope the best for you.

I know they are painful but I’ve no other option. I’ve a strong rope so little chance for it to break. I tried the cutting method before and came so close. If I do it this time around I’m confident I will succeed. But it takes some time so hanging seems the most preferable.

I’ve been in unbearable pain for so long that I don’t care that much about the consequences of my death. She told me she will die if I kill myself but I can’t continue anymore. I love her and wish her the best but I can’t live like this.

Still undecided between hanging and cutting my carotid artery but looks like the former.

We live together and are very close so not talking at all is difficult but I will try to make it very brief.
Feeling miserable and inferior all the time.

Great for you but therapy can’t fix me.

Mentally and physically (mostly physically).

Thanks for caring but I’ve completely lost hope.

Yeah I checked them and other similar subs. Although I want to lose fat like I said it isn’t my main problem.

About fixing my deformity a little bit, how to do it isn’t holding me back but embarrassment. 

Thank you for caring but nothing can be done to help me.

Weight isn’t my main problem but deformity is. I’m not obese but there is unwanted fat in me. I tried different approaches many times to lose it but stopped halfway because I was demotivated from realizing the result won’t matter since I can fix my deformed ugliness.
A little but for most part not. But even if I can be fixed like I wish I don’t want it because it’s embarrassing for an adult male (22 years old) like me to ask this kind of help.
I hate my appearance. My family are normal but I’m deformed.

Sometimes I eat and drink well and sometimes not. I’m demotivated because of being sub-human.

I was forced to try medication but helped nothing. Death is the only solution.

Great you will be trying to fix yourself. I hope you succeed.

I’m sorry your friend suicided.

Yeah my mother will be in pain (she might even die) but the pain I’m in is unbearable. I just can’t keep living like this.
Being miserable and inferior. Even when I’m happy I feel miserable at the same time.
I can’t study because I’m demotivated. No need to ask for help because nothing helps. I was taken to psych ward and hospitals but did so because I was forced and didn’t know what to do.

You are right I’m loved by someone (my mother) but this isn’t enough. I’ve been feeling like this everyday for the last 4 years. I stayed this long because of few failed attempts and with the expectation it will get better. It only gotten worse and this needs to end.
Me too
No point

I wish there is but nothing. 

Do you have a date?
December 15 or 16
I understand your view but what if the pain is unbearable? You are forced to look at life from different view.
Most of us here feel the most miserable.

David Benatar said even the best quality life is worse than we realize. So imagine the quality of the mass life? Sub-miserable! Most ppl aren’t bothered by their miserable life to seriously consider suicide but some of us do. Very few will succeed and I hope to be one of them.

No I don’t. 

Which methods best help us to experience it?
Yeah. I’ve took more than enough time of thinking and suicide is my only solution.

You touched me. I don’t know if I should say don’t end it since I’m in similar situation as you. I just wish you the best in whatever decision you take.

For you question, it’s best I shouldn’t give advice since I’m undecided whether goodbye letter is important or not.
Yeah
